pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take:
**Mustard Boy, look at me. LOOK AT ME. You thought Switzerland would carry you to glory? Well, they saved your bacon against Colombia, but your roster screams desperate mediocrity. At 43 points, you're stuck in third place like traffic on the I-405. Bubba G, you have the audacity to pit France against Morocco, your own picks going head-to-head like a WWE undercard match? Just because you’re sitting comfortably on top with 68 points doesn’t mean you’re running a soccer daycare. I'll tell you now, France will do the job with style, leaving you to question if you ever really knew the beautiful game.

And then there's Ghost Pepper, 58 points in second place—an offensive juggernaut on paper but a stunted midfielder in reality. Imagine pinning your hopes on Bosnia. Spain might save your skin for now, but your draft was as courageous as a defender diving into a pool of marshmallows. As for you, Backpass Assassin, your England pick is about as inspiring as a nil-nil draw on a soggy Tuesday night. And don’t get me started on Japan and Korea Republic—solid nations, sure, but your strategy is as unclear as a VAR decision gone wrong. Sitting at fourth with 39 points, you're just a bit too comfortable with mediocrity.

Meanwhile, The Noisemaker, standing at a humiliating last place with 29 points, you have three teams that didn't even qualify. How does that happen? Your first World Cup pool: think of it as a learning curve, not a death spiral. Let me predict, like the oracle I am: Germany will come out on top, but it won’t be enough to redeem the chaos you brought to this draft. Keep dreaming, gentlemen, because the real World Cup is about grit, not hot takes."
